subject: 4000 Mystic Valley Parkway Comprehensive Permit
overview: The Zoning Board of Appeals reviewed a revised waiver list, linkage fee calculations, and draft permit conditions for a proposed 350-unit M.G.L. Chapter 40B development. The public hearing was continued to June 12, 2023.

items.title: 4000 Mystic Valley Parkway 40B Comprehensive Permit
items.summary: The board reviewed updated waiver requests, discussed linkage fee credits, and examined draft permit conditions before continuing the public hearing to June 12, 2023.
